🔵 Do not mistake today’s model rankings for a permanent strategic verdict.
🔵 Strengthen the foundations of American leadership, such as research talent.
🔵 Avoid a single-track technology strategy.
🔵 Protect and cooperate selectively.
🔵 Monitor what China is actually building.

“One of the challenges of globalization is that the benefits were broadly distributed, but largely invisible,” while “the costs of globalization were very localized, very acute, and very visible. The factory in your town closed and moved to Mexico or moved to China,” CFR President @MikeFroman tells @nayeema, host of the Smart Girl Dumb Questions podcast. 

“Nobody walked out of a Walmart and said, ‘Thank goodness for the World Trade Organization.’ But it was the World Trade Organization and globalization generally that allowed them to go home and spend less and less of their income on their shoes, their clothing, their food, etc.”
